name: package_elder_ema_v1
description: Full-package additivity: baseline 4 strats + Elder Triple Screen with ETS2_TREND_MODE=ema_slope. The MACD tide was blocking all signals (Elder bounded probe failed hard). EMA slope is simpler: bullish when EMA slope > 0, bearish when slope < 0 — much wider gate. Also tests relaxed macd_hist (hist_sign=0, consec=1) as a middle path. Grid: 3*2*2*3*3*1 = 108 combos. Criterion: PF > 1.591 AND DD <= 7.0%.

_notes.fix_history: 2026-05-27: schema fix by Opus — score_weights added (was missing), corrected combo count from 54 to 108, added min_net_pnl + max_negative_streak constraints.
_notes.deploy_action: If winner: add ENABLE_ELDER_TRADING=1, ETS2_RISK_MULT=0.06, ETS2_MAX_OPEN_TRADES=1 + winner params to .env. Note: Elder traded well in bull-2024 — deploy only if regime turns bullish OR winner survives bear stress test.
hypothesis_notes: macd_hist was blocking Elder entirely — hist slope required to flip direction + be on correct zero side + N consec bars
ema_slope is purely: is EMA rising or falling? Much simpler, more signals
ETS2_TREND_REQUIRE_HIST_SIGN=0 relaxes macd_hist path (histogram just needs slope, not zero-crossing)
Wave oscillator kept as RSI for simplicity — Force Index needs volume data quality
